name: Virgil Birmire
source:
A high school student in the small town of Autumn Gray.

After a car accident took his father's life and left his twin brother in a coma, Virgil has become distant from the world around him.

His only source of solace is the online forum Shiniablo.

[From [url=http://www.thanatoscontract.godsibb.net/virgil.html]Official Site[/url]]
